title: 7 Levels of AI Trading
description:
Get the AI Quant Trading System that 180x My Portfolio: 
https://www.part-timequant.com/live

Most people start AI trading by asking ChatGPT, “Should I buy Apple?”

That is Level 1.

In this video, I’ll walk through all seven levels, from basic AI prompts and TradingView scripts to Python backtesting, machine learning, alternative data, portfolio risk management, and multi-agent trading systems.

The goal is not to pretend that AI guarantees profits. The goal is to understand what changes as you move from an AI chatbot to a properly tested quantitative workflow.

We’ll cover:

Level 1: The Prompt Guesser
Level 2: AI-generated trading scripts
Level 3: Python backtesting and trading costs
Level 4: Machine learning and market regimes
Level 5: AI research and alternative data
Level 6: Portfolio construction and risk control
Level 7: The autonomous multi-agent trading system

Watch the related tutorials:

How To Connect Claude to Trading View:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vIX6ztULs4U

How To Build A Self-Improving AI Trading Agent:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6njREUQAFdg

This video is educational and is not financial advice. Trading involves risk. Past performance and backtest results do not guarantee future returns.
